text: What does total correctness [P] C [Q] guarantee that partial correctness {P} C {Q} does not?
choices: That C terminates whenever P holds
That P is the weakest precondition
That the postcondition Q holds if C terminates
explanation: Total correctness adds the termination guarantee: whenever P holds, C halts AND Q holds. Choice 3 is exactly what partial correctness already provides, so it is not the distinguishing feature. Choices 0 and 2 are unrelated to the partial/total distinction.
